title: Inverse image of incoming page boundaries is successor boundaries
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex and $F$ a decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration]. Let $r\ge1$, $D$ differential data on the concrete quotient page [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential], $i=(p,q)$ and $n=p+q$. Write $Z_s,B_s$ for its graded cycles and boundaries [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Suppose $h:Z_{r+1}^{p,q}\le Z_r^{p,q}$ and $f:Z_{r+1}^{p,q}\to D.\mathrm{page}.\mathrm{cycles}(i)$ satisfies $f\,\iota=\mathrm{incl}_h\,\pi_r$. Let $t:D.\mathrm{page}.X(\mathrm{prev}(i))\to D.\mathrm{page}.\mathrm{cycles}(i)$ be the incoming differential factored through the kernel. Then $f^{-1}(\operatorname{im}t)$ is the subobject of $Z_{r+1}^{p,q}$ represented by the inclusion $B_{r+1}^{p,q}\hookrightarrow Z_{r+1}^{p,q}$ [lem-sp-filtered-complex-boundaries-le-cycles].

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle, boundary and differential formulas and lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: Write n = p+q. The image of the incoming page differential consists of classes of dx with x in F^(p-r)K^(n-1) and dx in F^pK^n. These are exactly the classes defining B_(r+1), modulo B_r. Indeed, the incoming r-cycle condition at filtration degree p-r is precisely that its differential lands in F^p. Use the representative equation for D in both directions, locally lifting along the epimorphic representative and quotient projections. The inverse image of this incoming image under f is B_(r+1) inside Z_(r+1): the additional ambiguity B_r already lies in B_(r+1). Both containments are therefore equalities of subobjects. All lifts used here are pullbacks along epimorphisms in the abelian category.

theorem filteredComplex_successor_boundaries_image
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (D : FilteredComplexPageDifferential K F r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hZ : F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) ≤
      F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r)
    (f : (F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) : C) ⟶ D.page.cycles pq)
    (hf : f ≫ D.page.iCycles pq =
        Subobject.ofLE _ _ hZ ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K F r pq) :
    (Subobject.pullback f).obj
      (imageSubobject (D.page.toCycles ((ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)).prev pq) pq)) =
      Subobject.mk (Subobject.ofLE _ _
        (filteredComplex_boundaries_le_cycles K F pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1)))
